test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph:

P. She gracefully finished with her arms up after landing flawlessly on both feet.

Q. She flipped and twisted her body in midair as she blasted herself off the springboard.

R. She ran briskly in the direction of the vault to start her routine.

S. With a faultless performance and a perfect score, she bowed to the judges and the audience.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph describes a gymnast's flawless performance, and the sentences need to be arranged to ensure a logical and coherent flow of events.
 
• **Sentence R is the first sentence** as it starts with the gymnast running toward the vault to begin the routine:
 
 
• "She ran briskly in the direction of the vault to start her routine."
